verdict.rationale: Paperspace ships an official CLI, pspace, with a first-party reference page and install docs ('Install and use the new Paperspace Command Line Interface'; 'Programmatically manage resources using the Paperspace Command Line Interface'). The docs also list it as a supported path for creating machines, and API keys work with the CLI. Missing for 10: details of command coverage and depth, agent-friendly features (e.g. structured/JSON output, non-interactive auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
